messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: New lines in facet title
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to figure out the best way to add a new line ("\n")character to facet titles. The only way I can think of is going into my data and adding a new line in the raw data, e.g., "Group 1" becomes "Group\n1" (similar to suggestion in previous post: https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/ggplot2/new$20line$20facet$20title/ggplot2/ME8rwCMy_DM/E2BUPZ8Am0wJ), so that when I factor the levels would match up. But I was hoping there was a way to just handle the titles themselves without touching the data. Is that possible?

Thanks,
Doug

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: New lines in facet title
parts:
Hi Doug,

I think you have to change the data, but that should be easy enough.
If you want to replace all the paces with newlines:

Dat <- data.frame(x=rnorm(10),
y=rnorm(10),
Group=rep(c("This string is quite long",
"This string is even longer than the other long string"),
each=5))

Dat$Group <- gsub(" ", "\n", Dat$Group)

If you want more complicated wrapping you can use str_wrap in the
stringr package:

library(stringr)
Dat$Group <- str_wrap(Dat$Group, width = 20)


Best,
Ista

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: New lines in facet title
parts:
I'm not opposed to the feature request, but personally I don't really
miss this. If you don't want to modify the original data you can
always do it on the fly:

Dat <- data.frame(x=rnorm(10),
y=rnorm(10),
Group=rep(c("This string is quite long",
"This string is even longer than the other long string"),
each=5))

library(stringr)

ggplot(transform(Dat,
Group = str_wrap(Group,
width = 20)),
aes(x=x, y=y)) +
geom_point()+
facet_wrap(~Group)

levels(Dat$Group) ## unchanged in Dat

Of course this is not a good approach is Dat is large, but in many
cases it will work just fine.

HTH,
Ista
